title: Attachments: skips, hover text, held items; rift toast
description: Research facilities (all four colours) count as technology skips in the technology picker's overview, in step with the engine's tech_specialties_now. Attachments show name and effect on hover/focus/tap wherever they are named, and the Held items panel shows text for every attachment (it was built only from resource/influence modifiers, so Demilitarized Zone and the Cybernetic Research Facility were empty). The gravity-rift toast and log line say what the die did to each ship instead of counting 'hits'. Before shots are taken at 80ce1bf1 (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- GF. Synthetic boards through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: tech skips row with research facilities (desktop)
shots.caption: Only planets with a printed specialty are listed: the Warfare Research Facility on Jord and the Cybernetic one on Tar'mann are invisible (Tar'mann's printed green skip is there, without the facility's yellow one).

shots.heading: After: tech skips row with research facilities (desktop)
shots.caption: Jord lists a red skip with '+ Warfare Research Facility'; Tar'mann (exhausted, unusable) shows its printed green badge and the facility's yellow one next to it; Wellon (printed yellow) with the +1/+1 side of a facility adds no skip.

notes.title: Rift toast ship names
notes.text: The engine's public roll does not say which ship rolled, so the line says 'the ship'. Naming it needs a display field on the roll (no rules change).
